why: check_alignment asks whether this frame has diverged from the predecessor without declaring it. Held only by reference, it reported NOT_RUN on every checkout without the sibling installed — and an undeclared divergence is exactly the thing that goes unnoticed when nobody can run the check.
rule: The sibling is preferred when installed; this is the fallback and it is a SNAPSHOT. Drift in the sibling since this hash is invisible to a run that falls back, which is the honest cost of being able to run at all, and the reason the hash is here.
